label_policy.full_binary_coverage: Every image is judged for every intent. Chinese and English pairs have identical positive lists and full binary rows.
label_policy.composition: All requested clauses must be satisfied by one target device unless the query explicitly names a relationship between devices.
label_policy.multiple_device_image: An image may be relevant when one device satisfies the query even if another device in the same image does not; e026 is intentionally a per-device ownership case.
label_policy.visibility_negation: No visible fins or bushings means the attribute is not visibly exposed on the selected device in this photo, not that the device physically lacks the component.
label_policy.wiring: Attached individual insulated wires/cables count as visible wiring; a protective conduit alone, an unattached fitting, or a printed terminal label does not.
label_policy.cooling_fins: Explicit exposed repeated fin/radiator elements qualify. Door louvers and unspecified casing ribs do not establish transformer cooling fins.
label_policy.device_identity: Function may be supported by source metadata; filenames do not establish SKU, exact physical identity, or ratings.
label_policy.reference_english: Reference pairs are not translator input and do not replace any generated translation.

limitations: All40 images are reused from the existing gallery; new language intents do not form an independent field-image test set.
Labels and bilingual references are assistant-authored and visually/source checked by that assistant, with no independent human or electrical-engineering audit.
Several intents deliberately have one genuine positive in this small gallery; estimates will be sensitive to individual images.
The e026 finned right transformer and smooth left transformer make device ownership important; photo-level term presence alone cannot establish relevance.
e006 supports a visible metal post/array support, not a wooden-post assertion. The direct fastener interface is partly hidden by the inverter casing.
Coarse source captions cannot prove every requested visual detail; e016 is annotated as blue panel, not blue sockets, and e005 ribs are not assigned an unverified cooling function.
Visibility negation reflects the photograph and cannot prove component absence outside the view.
Do not adjust these texts, references or labels after translation/ranking inspection; a correction requires a new query-set version and reevaluation.

issue_log_handoff.evidence: All original e001-e040 reused; no independent human labels. Preserve this qualification in every report.
Right transformer has explicit radiator fins; left smooth cylinder does not. t10 and t11 may both be relevant using different target devices.
e016 blue front panel, not blue socket claim; e006 metal support, not wood; e005 visible ribs only; e024 louvers not exposed radiator-fin credit.
Most compositional intents have one positive; t04, t10 and t11 have multiple positives. Do not overgeneralize aggregate differences.
t03 no attached wires; t11 no visible fins on selected device; t13 no visible top bushings. Inclusion of a glossary word is not sufficient for semantic fidelity.
